_comment: The bad case, one job per deny rule, so a rule that stops firing shows up here rather than in production. Must FAIL. Every entry is modelled on a real job measured on this machine on 2026-08-24.

jobs.label: com.example.blinded
jobs._why: The monitoring outage case, added 2026-08-24 after it happened for real. Healthchecks went unhealthy, bin/placement-audit wrote check:null for all 34 monitored jobs, and the never-pinged rule silently stopped matching because rego treats null.last_ping as undefined rather than null. Eleven real failures disappeared and the run reported 11 instead of 22 -- the guard got QUIETER when it went blind. This row exists so that can never pass again.
